home.pickTheater: Pick a theater in the top bar to get started.
home.noTheater: Your account has no theater assigned. Please contact an administrator.
home.comingSoon: Ticketing, gate and warehouse tools will appear here soon.

login.heroSubtitle: Sell tickets, scan at the gate and manage stock at the counter.
login.title: Staff Login
login.subtitle: Please sign in with a theater staff account.
login.notStaffAccount: This account is not a theater staff account. Please sign in with a staff account.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.message: This account may not use the staff tools. Please sign in with a staff account.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Stock levels of tracked food and drinks per theater.

settings.title: Stock settings
settings.trackHint: When tracking is on, sales deduct stock and the item cannot be sold when it runs out.
settings.thresholdHint: The item is flagged as low stock at or below this quantity.
settings.targetHint: Restock plans suggest topping the item up to this quantity.
settings.openingHint: Quantity currently on hand. Required when switching tracking on.

movement.title: Adjust / waste
movement.adjustHint: Adjustment: enter a signed change, for example 5 to add or -3 to remove.
movement.wasteHint: Waste: enter a positive quantity, it cannot exceed the stock on hand.

errors.range: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100000.
errors.exceedsOnHand: Cannot exceed the stock on hand.
errors.noteRequired: A note is required when the reason is Other.

list.title: Storage plans
list.subtitle: Plan, approve and receive stock for your theater.

detail.subtitle: Items can be edited while the plan is a draft or was rejected.
detail.rejectedHint: Edit the plan and save it to return it to draft, then submit it again.
detail.noItems: No items yet. Add at least one product.

receive.title: Receive stock
receive.hint: Enter the quantity actually received for each item. Stock is increased by these amounts.

errors.datePast: The target date cannot be in the past.
errors.plannedRange: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 100000.
errors.receivedRange: Must be a whole number from 0 to 100000.
errors.noItems: Add at least one item to the plan.

warehouse.pickTheaterHint: Choose a theater in the top bar; warehouse data is kept per theater.

gate.title: Ticket gate
gate.subtitle: Scan tickets at the entrance, or look a booking up by code or phone.
gate.pickTheaterHint: Pick the theater you are working at in the top bar to scan tickets.
gate.scanPlaceholder: Scan or type the ticket code, then press Enter
gate.ageQuestion: This film is rated {{age}}+. Did you check the patron's age?

lookup.hint: Shows today's paid tickets for this theater.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.subtitle: Sensitive staff actions, who did them and who approved them.
auditLog.empty: No audit entries match these filters.

pinSettings.title: Manager override PIN
pinSettings.hint: Staff at the counter can ask you to approve sensitive actions by typing this PIN. Choose 4 to 8 digits and keep it private.
pinSettings.pinInvalid: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits.
pinSettings.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.

afterSales.title: After-sales desk
afterSales.subtitle: Find an invoice to refund, exchange or reprint its tickets.
afterSales.pickTheaterHint: Use the theater picker in the top bar.

search.title: Find an invoice
search.hint: Type an invoice code or a phone number to search.

panel.title: Invoice {{code}}
panel.pinRequired: A manager PIN is required for these actions.
panel.showStarted: The showtime has already started. A refund now needs a manager PIN.

refund.title: Refund invoice
refund.hint: The whole invoice is refunded and the seats are released.
refund.hintAfterStart: The showtime has already started. This refund needs a manager PIN and is recorded as an after-start refund.
refund.successOutOfBand: Invoice {{code}} marked refunded ({{amount}}). Return the money outside the system.

error.noteRequired: A note is required when the reason is Other.
error.tenderRequired: Choose how the money is returned.
error.referenceRequired: Enter the terminal or wallet reference for a card or QR refund.

exchange.disabledTip: Exchange is coming soon: it needs the replacement-sale picker from the point of sale.
exchange.notEligibleTip: Only paid counter sales without used tickets can be exchanged (and exchange is not available yet).

reprint.title: Reprint tickets
reprint.hint: Reprints are audited. Give the reason.
reprint.hintUsed: A ticket on this invoice was already used: a manager PIN is required to reprint it.
reprint.reasonShort: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.

cashClose.title: Cash close
cashClose.subtitle: Close your drawer and review the day.
cashClose.pickTheaterHint: Use the theater picker in the top bar.

drawer.title: Drawer {{terminal}}
drawer.countInvalid: Enter the amount counted, zero or more.
drawer.reconcileHint: A variance needs a manager to reconcile the drawer after closing.
drawer.needsReconciliation: The drawer is closed with a variance. A manager must reconcile it.
drawer.confirmMessage: The count is final once the drawer is closed.
drawer.noOpenDrawerHint: Open a drawer from the point of sale first.

daily.pendingHint: These drawers closed with a variance. Reconcile them once checked.
daily.noDrawers: No drawer sessions on this day.

reconcile.title: Reconcile drawer
reconcile.hint: Confirm the variance has been checked. The note is kept in the audit trail.
